label: recheck-d
tail:
All three of my pairs are **ready for splice**; the machine half is updated.

**What the re-check found.** Every `applied` entry in both Betas' fix passes is true of disk — I opened each changed file rather than reading the claim. Batch 2's item-48 contract really was rewritten from the abandoned Dedekind route to the counting route (19 citations, none of the five dependencies I removed), the square-map lemma really has a contract and a `scope` row (114), and the Kaur–Kulshrestha source really is harvested and live: I fetched `arxiv.org/pdf/1510.06583` in this dispatch — 246050 bytes, matching the Beta's stamp — and its §2 and §2.1 carry the polar-map definition and `q(xZ(G))=x²` verbatim as harvested. Batch 9's B9-1 contract has real steps 4.1/4.2/5.1 where a one-line hand-wave stood, and B9-2's corollary has all eight boundary rows dispositioned with substantive reasons.

**One defect neither of us had caught, repaired here.** The square-map lemma's contract cites `prop-equivalent-characterisations-of-an-extraspecial-p-group` and `def-special-and-extraspecial-p-groups`, and neither was in the item's `deps` — `citation-undeclared-dependency` after step 5, the same defect the Beta had just repaired for item 48, reintroduced at the seam because I wrote the item and it wrote the contract. Both are load-bearing at step 1.1 and both are earlier on the page; I added them to `research/frontier-18-batch-2.pages.json`. A sweep of every contract in both batches now reports zero undeclared citations.

**One pushback accepted — my step-3 report was wrong.** I wrote that `batch-a-pair-cap` runs at `3-review`, `3-fix`, `3-recheck`, `4-splice` and `5-author`. From `stages/mathlib.mts` it runs at `1-scaffold`, `3-fix`, `5-author` and `6c-cross`; three of five entries were wrong. The split decision is unchanged and better supported. I also re-verified the `planGate()` list the no-sixty-first-item constraint rests on — that one was right apart from `1-drift` where I wrote `2-assign` — and marked both corrections in the step-3 review itself so step 4 does not inherit them.

Gates after my edit: content-policy 202/0/0, coverage-checklist 345 rows/0/0, both splice dry-runs clean (143 and 59 items), url-sweep 9/9 live, source-backing 132 results all backed, fetch-check 9/9. `scaffold-verdicts --require-sufficient` reports 14/14 reviewed and 4 insufficient — **none of them mine**; `3-recheck` is held by `lattice-paths-and-catalan-numbers`, `modules-substitution-and-prime-graphs`, `the-divergence-theorem-and-classical-stokes` and `lebesgue-measure-on-euclidean-space` in groups `a` and `b`.

Two seams carried to step 6, neither a defect now: `def-set-weighted-limit-and-weighted-colimit` must state `M` locally small, since three weighted-half titles rely on it silently and the definition's Statement does not exist yet; and `lem-orthogonal-complement-counting-for-the-commutator-pairing` must not drift into a rank–nullity phrasing, which would be a forward reference to order 92.
